variables.label: Shards - Visible fraction of the broken volume (Powder amount)
Shards - Ambient dust motes around the object (the experiment had 40)
Break - Last break: eject speed and speed cap multiplier
Break - Follow-up slice radius (sets their spacing too)
Tune break - Cut threshold (surface gone above this erosion)
Tune break - Crumbly edge band width
Tune break - Brush softness (edge falloff of a slice)
Tune break - Crumble rate along cracks (high = the whole shape goes at once)
Tune break - Crumble duration after a stroke
Flight - Eject spread along the normal
Flight - Drag (speed decays by this per second)
Flight - Turbulence decay with age (low = keeps swirling)
Flight - Clump cohesion (shards orbit a leader; 0 = none)
Flight - Shards follow the object motion for (s; 30 = whole flight)
Flight - Settle time (velocity is killed after this; 12 = never)
Flight - Organic drift once settled (curl noise)
Flight - Push out of the solid shape while it breaks
Flight - Push range outside the surface
Flight - Push away from the shape centre (clears pockets and the hole)
Assembly - Region / noise size
variables.description: Larger values form broader connected patches. Noise is evaluated only on retarget.

variables.label: Return - Wave spread (nearest shards leave first, seconds)
Return - Distance over which the wave spreads
Return - Per-shard stagger (random delay up to this)
Return - Fill-in rate for voxels no shard returns to
Return - Spring ramp-in (seconds until it pulls at full strength)
Return - Speed cap on the way home
Return - Shards turn to lie on the surface (0 = keep tumbling)
Return - Alignment curve over the flight home (1 linear, higher = later)
Light - Fill intensity (hemisphere, diffuse only: barely shows on clear ice)
Light - Environment softbox (the main light on glass)

options.label: Full (baked look; needs a real GPU)
Lite (the source ?lite profile for software WebGPU)

variables.label: Shape voxel resolution
variables.description: Resolution of the logo and text distance fields. Rebuilds shapes; higher values increase startup time and memory. Independent of breakup resolution.

variables.label: Performance - Erosion field resolution (voxels per axis)
Shape - Logo mesh detail (1-4; higher = finer surface)
Assembly - Outward spread vs seam travel
Type - Headline block width (the mark is 2.6 wide)
Type - Extrusion depth (fraction of the font size)
Type - Bevel (fraction of the font size)
Type - Corner rounding (fraction of the font size)
Type - Text mesh detail (1-4; higher = smoother deformation)
